source_diagnosis.generator_defect: All205 seed INSERTs run before ALTER TABLE trigger restores without first draining retained deferred infrastructure_commit events. PG17.11 ALTER TABLE checks reject pending AFTER events on the relation with55006.
source_diagnosis.proposed_correction: In a NEW packet, SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE after the last seed INSERT and before the first restore ALTER. Run retained checks while bypassed guards remain in the same exact reviewed scope; a retained-check failure must still stop and roll back.
source_diagnosis.not_an_enforcement_relaxation: No additional trigger disables, constraint deferral, data repair, schema/ACL changes, permission expansion or owner qualification; only earlier execution of already-retained checks.

primary_sources.supports: ALTER checks active-use and pending AFTER-trigger events; both use object_in_use
IMMEDIATE retroactively executes outstanding deferred constraints, including constraint triggers, and fails if a check fails
